editorial:
Imagine you are a hardworking construction guy who just wants a quiet life, but then some bad people push you too far. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow a man who decides he has had enough and starts playing vigilante at night. Things get really messy when he accidentally crashes a huge drug deal, putting a target on his back. When the scary cartel boss kidnaps his wife, the movie turns into a high-stakes rescue mission. It feels like one of those classic revenge stories where a regular guy turns into a killing machine to save the person he loves most.

The action is punchy and keeps you moving, though some of the plot points are a bit predictable. You will appreciate the grit and the way the main character uses his building skills to take down the bad guys. It is not a fancy film, but it delivers exactly what you want from an action flick.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, you see the construction worker use his knowledge of the environment to trap the cartel members. He fights his way through the boss's guards in a brutal series of fights. He eventually faces the cartel boss and kills him in a satisfying way to ensure he can never hurt anyone again. He rescues his wife, and they leave the chaos behind, finally finding some peace after the revenge is complete.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and hard-hitting action.
